name: md-prompt
description: Paints Markdown onto Claude Code's prompt box as you type: fenced code becomes a syntax-highlighted card (even before you close the fence), and inline code, bold, italic, lists, task lists, quotes, tables, links and headings are styled. Paint only, your text is never changed.

mode.title: Markdown painting
mode.description: on: paint everything. code: paint only fenced code and inline code. off: leave the prompt box as plain text. /md-prompt on|code|off changes it too.
